BEFORE WE GET STARTED
Know exactly what you are paying for.
A starting price is a guide to the initial scope. It is not a fixed price for every project or a bundle of all six services.
How is my final price decided?

Share your goals, required pages or workflows, integrations, content and preferred deadline. We review the requirements and provide a quote with an agreed scope. Additional requests can increase the price and are agreed before the extra work starts.
Are there any separate running costs?

Domains, hosting, paid themes or plugins, third-party subscriptions, payment processing, advertising and AI/API usage are separate unless explicitly included in your proposal. Any applicable taxes and billing schedule are confirmed in the quote.
Can I combine more than one service?

Yes. Tell us which services you need and we will prepare a combined proposal. The website starting price does not include a separate branding project, SEO campaign, online store or automation project.
What happens after I enquire?
We clarify your requirements, confirm deliverables, pricing and milestones, and share a proposal for your approval. Sending an enquiry does not start paid work.
